We have officially merged the Mac branch with the default branch. This means that all Mac players will now be playing the latest version on the default branch alongside all other PC players. You should not notice any changes in gameplay as a result of this merge.

In addition, we will be closing the open beta branch on Thursday, January 18th at 11:00 AM CEST. This is because we now have a newer, more stable version of Gloomhaven available. Deleting the old beta branch will help to reduce the number of potential bugs that could occur from cross-versioning.
If you would like to keep playing the older version of Gloomhaven, you can still access it by staying on or switching to the "V28009" branch.

Please note that neither the "open beta" branch nor the "V28009" branch are compatible with the current and updated "default" branch. This means that you will not be able to switch back from the "open beta" branch nor the "V28009" branch to the default branch without losing your progress.

For those still playing on the open beta branch and willing to go to the V28009 branch to keep their saves, you will have to move your save FROM: C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven\GloomSavesOpenBeta: TO: C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven\GloomSaves
To access the V28009 branch, follow these steps:
Open the Steam client.
Click on the "Library" tab.
Right-click on "Gloomhaven" and select "Properties".
Click on the "Betas" tab.
In the "Beta participation" field, select "V28009".
Click on the "Close" button.
The game will now be updated to the "V28009" branch.

Some of you let us know that you didn't like the "skip" and "undo" button being swapped for keyboard and mouse users.: We will be adding an option in the next update to switch these controls on your will.

Some context: This change was made to ensure a strong UX on consoles. It is intuitive to have the Cancel option on Circle (B) and the Skip option on Square (X) as that is the norm in the industry. This change was implemented onto PC to ensure a cohesive experience and similar button placement for all platforms.

We're actively addressing a list of known issues for our upcoming updates, and your input is incredibly valuable to us.: If you encounter any bugs, please consider sharing your reports and information with us by submitting a ticket here: https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/contact-us/: Your help will aid us in resolving these issues as fast and efficiently as possible.

On another note, some of you have mentioned that the support form didn't work properly.: We checked on our side and it is usually linked to either a captcha or field not being filled out, or a report being heavier than 25Mo. If you have video that doesn't fit the first submitting form, you simply need to open a ticket with our support team without it, and then you will be able to share it with them.

releases.displayName: Quality of Life Update & Steam Achievements

items.text: Standing in front of an ominous dungeon, Spellweaver did not feel as confident now as she did back at the tavern. Over there, she would gloat about how she earned all of these achievements. But other mercenaries challenged her, and she had to show them all... as bragging only gets you so far.
And let me tell you, her companions did not make things any easier.
Scoundrel spent quite a while staring obsessively at a nearby chest, visibly trapped, and muttering “Mine…All Mine”.
Brute, for his part, repeatedly yelled “I’ll kill them all!" and "Get over Here!” at an immobile skeleton, amidst a sea of profanities.

Suddenly, she caught movement in the shadows of the dungeon. Hungry things lurking, waiting, observing. A shiver ran down her spine, but the job had to be done. With a grim grin, she starting preparing a chromatic explosion...
A normal day in Gloomhaven.
We are gathered here today to celebrate the new update, containing a lot of new content, many bug fixes and the awaited Steam achievements.
You can find more details below.

notes.title: MACOS RELEASE DAY HAS COME UPON US

items.text: Good day, glorious adventurers!
Today is generous with us, as Gloomhaven is finally available on macOS.
*YAY*
We worked hard to release a macOS version that would be fully stable and of a quality level we deemed appropriate for Gloomhaven players.
As of right now, we are happy to announce that we have met the standards we set for the macOS version to be released, hence this brilliant update.
We are very excited to be giving macOS players the opportunity to join us on Gloomhaven.
Welcome!
You will find below the minimum and recommended specs to run Gloomhaven on your beloved and dear macOS!
MINIMUM
OS Version: Big Sur (11)
Processor: 2.7GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: 4 GB
RECOMMENDED
OS Version: Monterey (12)
Processor: 3.2GHz
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: 8 GB
MERCENARIES!
We heard you.
We received lots of feedback regarding the enhancements and randomness issues, and thanks to you all, we have been able to carefully evaluate and discuss these topics.
The next major update coming in December will thus implement the following changes:

We are working on implementing the permanent enhancements for the retirement system from the original board game to the Gloomhaven Digital Campaign. This will be a toggleable option in the campaign that will allow a mercenary to keep their enhancements after they’re retired. Consequently, if you or another member of your party wants to play the same character, the unlocked enhancements will remain.
In the non-permanent enhancements mode, the enhancements’ pricing will be reduced and rebalanced to allow you to create new build ideas. These changes were approved by Isaac Childres and his team.

This board game variant allows players to reduce the variance in damage caused by the x2 (or “Bless”) and x0 (or “Curse”) attack modifiers by instead treating them as a +2 and -2 modifiers respectively.
> These are two of the numerous improvements and changes we will be bringing in the upcoming update next month.
We felt it was cool to let you know we were working on these specific two as there has been a huge demand and tons of feedback about it, and since we’re cool, too. <
STEAM AWARDS
Steam Award Nominations are open now!
It would really mean a lot to us to even make the short list for an award, and we can think of none better than the "Best Game You Suck At" Award.
"This is the game that rewards persistence, and is not for the faint of heart. It's the toughest game we've ever loved."
So get your votes in and tell all your friends and family to do the same!

items.text: Once back in the capital, your steps instinctively led you to the most popular and busy shopping street in the city. Along the long cobbled street, you hear chitter-chatter about a newcomer...
Gather around, guildmasters, as we welcome in our beautiful town the (Saw) Sawbones.

Humans are by far the most dominant of the races. Their society is one of rules and regulations, but also one of great diversity. Due to their intense curiosity and relentless nature, humans can find themselves walking almost any path imaginable – from the obscenely wealthy noble to the unappreciated tavern cook; from the blacksmith forging rugged weaponry to the corrupted pursuant of dark magics.
Perhaps one of the most respected professions in human society is to serve the Great Oak.
Human Sawbones are religious healers operating under the Great Oak. They are respected members of society, but contrary to popular belief do not rely on magic for most of their healing prowess.
This instead comes from knowledge passed from the researchers of the Great Oak.. and from the swift amputation of infected limbs.

Followers of the Oak are religious healers who do their best to ward off the pestilence and death that can manifest in larger human cities. Contrary to popular belief, however, there is nothing miraculous about their healing methods, as anyone who has come to them with a gangrenous leg knows all too well. The mystique of the profession can get lost amongst the screams when the Sawbone has to hack off a limb.

Being an offensive support, Saw is an excellent melee damage-dealer with an incredible capacity for crowd control. As you recruit him, will you prefer his heavy crowd control or his healing and damage?

items.text: Your steps have led you to the gates of the city. You have just heard the news: two newcomers are looking to join the fight. Will you succeed in recruiting them for your own guild?
Esteemed guildmasters, let me introduce you to the (Squid Face) Plagueherald.
Harrower Plagueheralds are a small sect of Harrowers who are one of the main reasons the entire species is in disrepute among polite Gloomhaven society.
Either misguided or ignorant of other races’ physiology, Plague Heralds believe that the spread of disease throughout a society will strengthen it and propel it towards great things.

“Harrower” is only the name given to this race in the common tongue, as the name in their own language of chitters and hisses cannot be easily translated. A single Harrower, as typically seen by other races, is actually a swarm of thousands of insects who have merged their intelligence to form a hive mind capable of highly sophisticated thought.

They are a squishy ranged character, and thus you will want to avoid putting yourself in a position to take hits. They specialize in reducing the effectiveness of enemies or putting debuffs on enemies that will make your allies’ attacks more effective through the use of Curse and Poison.
But be wary of allying with a Plagueherald, fellow adventurers, as their ability to spread decay and death across both sides of a battlefield is a terrifying thing to behold.
Let me keep you around a little longer as yet another mercenary has arrived in town.
Meet the (Angry Face) Doomstalker!

Though most Orchids live a life of meditation, there is a sect who believes that enlightenment should be achieved through hard work and not getting lost in thought for years on end. Because of its beliefs, the sect fled Orchid society across the Misty Sea to build farms and raise livestock in the wilds around Gloomhaven. The wilds are still dangerous, however, and the Orchid class of Doomstalkers is tasked with keeping these modest settlements safe.

The calm mind of the Orchid makes the Doomstalker an excellent bow hunter. He never misses a shot. The Doomstalker is a medium-hp, giant hand-size ranged damage-dealer. And ranged damage-dealer he is, as he can inflict some really high damage from quite far away. His Doom mechanic also means that he has a unique rhythm to his playstyle that you will need to learn to master.

Fellow mercenaries, welcome to town the (Three Spears) Quartermaster.

Though their demon-like qualities make them feared by many, Valrath Quartermasters pride themselves on integrating well into the rest of inter-species society. It is not uncommon, then, for an army or city garrison to employ a Valrath as a Quartermaster.
But lucky for you, guildmasters, skilled Quartermasters have also been known to aid smaller adventuring parties.

He is a versatile melee character who can occasionally tank as well as support allies by maximizing the effectiveness of their equipment. After all, what is a warrior without a good sword at his side?
But do not let it fool you, as his ability to lend a hand to his team surely doesn’t lessen his prowess to master multiple weapons and skills.
The only other question you will have to answer is just how much you want to use his support side compared to his damage and tanking capacities.
Do not leave yet as we are also here to formally introduce you to another new mercenary.
Meet the (Circles) Summoner!
Being an Aesther Summoner, she is a particular type of Aesther.

Her thirst for knowledge often gets the best of her and entices her to use their reality-bending powers to hunt it down. As a Summoner, she has learnt to coordinate her interplanar existence to transport anything, imaginable or not, between planes.
However, this quickly exhausts her, so she will often stick to living things and raw energy, which are easiest to summon.

She is a powerful range character who can both summon allies to the battlefield to support the party, and summon "raw energy" from across the planar boundaries in the form of ranged attacks. Her magic abilities arsenal is formidable, but it will be a challenge to learn how to make use of summoned allies effectively. Be humble and wise as your progress!

“As you walk through the streets of Gloomhaven a foul stench awakens your senses. Your head immediately jerks up at the sudden odour that permeates your very being. As you gaze around you notice a group of mercenaries which are walking past, covered in a variety of severe injuries, slime and waste… as you glance back along the path of wet footprints they left, you notice they lead to an open sewer grate in the city’s street. You wonder what would drive adventurers to explore such a horrible place, then it dawns on you; fame and gold! You hurry to your guild, ready to lead your mercenaries on a new adventure!”

notes.title: PREPARE TO VENTURE INTO THE SEWERS

items.text: The latest release for Gloomhaven has arrived; prepare to adventure into the dark and seedy underbelly of the city, a place where disgusting, dangerous and powerful foes lurk. In this new update, we will be releasing a mass of new content that you will be able to explore, combat and use to your advantage! With an entirely new Biome, the Sewers, you will encounter four new enemies, a new boss, and even two new mercenaries that have found their way into town!

notes.title: WINTER HAS COME TO GLOOMHAVEN, SO TO HAVE SALES!

items.text: If the frigid winds outside, or the cries of your friends have not already lured you to create your own guild in Gloomhaven, then this might do the trick! Until January 05, Gloomhaven’s Early access is discounted by 32% as a part of the Steam Winter Sale. Be sure to tell your friends, family, Inox neighbour and anyone else who will listen. Travel the lands of Gloomhaven together as you crush your foes, gaining fame and fortune in the process!

notes.title: GATHER YOUR MERCENARIES: TWO NEW RECRUITS HAVE ARRIVED!

items.text: Two powerful new mercenaries have managed to find their way to this town and are looking for a guild to join.

Recruit the (Eclipse) Nightshroud; not only the first Aesther to join your guild, but he is a powerful melee character who is capable of dealing large amounts of damage and has easy access to stealth abilities.The Nightshroud does however suffers from subpar movement options and inconsistent damage, so make sure you equip and build your team for this!

Don’t forget that the (Phoenix) Beast Tyrant has arrived in town as well. This mercenary is a powerful Vermling accompanied by an unbearably massive companion! This means that this mercenary has the bonus of working with 2 health bars. He is an effective tank, wielding powerful crowd control capabilities and numerous unique summons. But be wary of your bear, it has a mind of its own so controlling it correctly is the key to your success!

notes.title: FACE FOUR NEW CREATURES AND JOURNEY ON 18 NEW MISSIONS!

items.text: Take on any of the numerous new missions that are available in The Sewers update! With this new patch, 7 story, 4 relic and 7 journey missions have just been revealed by the town crier; so grab your weapons and find out what dark secrets and unimaginable treasures lie in wait for you! On top of this, alongside being able to visit these new zones, you will also encounter 4 ghastly new enemies!

We have made extensive changes to the YML for this release in order to improve things for modding. The downside of this is that all gameplay mods are invalidated by this change and will need to be updated before they work again (language mods will still work though). The current release only supports Language mods as we are still in progress with the rest of this change, but once it is released we will support a lot of new functionality that has been asked for by the modding community.
Please read the full details here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/780290/discussions/0/5575984402938252279/

Much more awaits you in this new patch, including an all new Multiplayer ping system which can be used with a simple double click on a hexagon, bug fixes, UI/UX updates and tweaks, new features and far more. Be sure to head on over to the Sleeping Lion and gather your guildmates to explore the world as it continues to open up before you! If you’re interested in seeing the full list of changes in The Sewers patch, be sure to review the full patch notes here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/780290/discussions/0/1643169167151064379/#c2994296376456544564

issues.text: -Sometimes at the end of a scenario it brings you to the results screen with no button.
-In Multiplayer, issue can occur after a character levels up - you can work around this by rejoining after leveling up.
-Joining mid-scenario can cause problems if there is a spawner in the scenario. A workaround is to ensure all players are present from round 1.
We are working on a patch for these issues asap.
Burning a card while retaliating and killing an enemy causes an error.
Doomstalker Dooms can cause some softlocks in multiplayer.
Using the circle to switch initiative can sometimes get ignored in multiplayer.

The "black screen" issue people are encountering while starting the campaign is due to videos (in this case the intro) not being played properly by older OS versions (typically Windows 7 is not officially supported). We will come up with a fix but a common workaround for now is to delete all video files from this folder : ...\steamapps\common\Gloomhaven\GH_Data\StreamingAssets\Movies
Desyncs may occur if 2 characters of the same class are in the roster at the same time in Multiplayer, avoid creating duplicate versions of the same character class while we work on a fix
Desyncs may occur if clients join while other players are creating new mercs, try to avoid that while we work on a fix

Scenario 76 Harrower Hive its best to avoid this scenario at the moment, getting a certain road event can result in the save being stuck at the start of this scenario, we are testing a fix for this currently and aiming to get this patched over the weekend.

Issue with Sun Level 9 ability in Multiplayer Divine Intervention, an error occurs if this ability is active and an ally summon is attacked that is being controlled by a client again, testing a fix and aiming to patch over the weekend.
Its possible to click the Short Rest button immediately after performing a Short rest which can result in an error, testing a fix and aiming to patch over the weekend.
